### [BFH Continuing Education](bfh-weiterbildung/)

A progressive series of courses on AI in education, offered through BFH continuing education (Weiterbildung). Three levels: Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced.

### [CAS University Didactics](cas-hochschuldidaktik/)

Module 4 of the CAS Hochschuldidaktik program, focusing on AI in higher education teaching.
